remediations.action: Body line 29: 'Self-determination is the precondition' → 'Self-determination functions as the precondition'. Line 37: 'The first is / The second is / The third is' → 'The first component covers / The second covers / The third establishes'. Line 45: 'This is not a new dynamic; automation has always shifted; What differs is' → 'This dynamic does not break new ground; automation historically shifts; What changes involves'.

Politician lens: 'self-determination is the precondition' → 'self-determination functions as the precondition'. Educator lens: 'the question is not only' → 'the question asks not only'. Researcher lens: 'the right to self-determination is fundamental' → 'the right to self-determination stands as fundamental'.

Summary: 'the right to economic self-determination is not merely aspirational — it describes the exact terrain at stake' → 'the right to economic self-determination reaches beyond aspiration — it names the structural terrain that AI-driven labor displacement enters, a terrain the United States has chosen to leave unaccountable'.

'automation has always shifted returns toward capital' → 'automation historically shifts short-run returns toward capital, with longer-run distributional outcomes varying by policy context'. Historical economics hedge applied.

Covered by f3 remediation — summary rewrite removes both the E-prime violation and the definitional overclaim, replacing with interpretive framing that names the terrain without asserting axiomatic status.

Voter lens: 'is precisely what Article 1 protects' → 'falls within the scope of what Article 1 was written to protect — though that application to AI remains contested in international law'. E-prime violation and interpretive overclaim both addressed.

'the structural pattern Article 1 addresses recurs in a new form. The CESCR has not issued a general comment applying Article 1 to digital resources — the scholarship and jurisprudence on this intersection remain nascent.' → 'the structural pattern Article 1 addresses appears to recur in a new form — though no CESCR General Comment has yet applied the doctrine to digital resources, and the scholarship on this intersection remains nascent.' Inline hedge moved to claim site; redundant follow-on sentence removed.
